stem: Based on information in the selection, what is the most likely reason the author includes the photograph of the baby elephant standing close to its mother?

options.label: A
options.text: To suggest that the baby elephant is warning its mother that there is danger nearby

options.label: B
options.text: To show the reader what the baby elephant does to try to get its mother to play with it

options.label: C
options.text: To show the reader what the baby elephant does when it wants its mother to know it is hungry

options.label: D
options.text: To suggest that the baby elephant feels safe and protected when it is near its mother
